clarified_intent.description: Independently validate that the completed React 19/Vite 8 change satisfies its bounded plan acceptance criteria and can proceed to adversarial review without implying npm publication authority.

specification.constraint_source: KBD generic constraint template plus task-specific constraints because .kbd-orchestrator/constraints.md is absent

target_state.description: A reproducible QA bundle with zero blocking violations, explicit evidence limits, and no registry mutation claim.
success_criteria: Every React plan acceptance criterion maps to direct current evidence.
Source-workspace browser evidence is never substituted for packed-package evidence.
All nine owned scenarios and DevTools diagnostics are represented.
Both browser receipts retain separate hash-matched artifacts.
Coverage, docs, Changesets, and evidence paths agree.
Publication remains unauthorized until immutable rehearsal and protected staging.

unknowns: External npm trusted-publisher and protected-environment authority cannot be proven by repository artifacts.
The current working source is not an immutable candidate SHA.
Firefox, WebKit, mobile-browser, live remote services, and broader Flutter/Tauri gates remain outside this change.
